description: Default paper benchmark edit-cell selector. It uses the attention percentile calibrated from the good showcase top-23 seed selection, then applies a small connectivity smoothing pass. The number of edit cells is data-dependent, not fixed.
notes: Use this as the default for future paper-style HNSCC HPV region mining.
The historical smoothed-28 showcase selector is preserved in configs/edit_cell_selection/showcase_smoothed28.json for exact reproduction only.
